All fair points - and they’re mostly symptoms, not root causes.  Spot => perps => options is the natural order, but crypto stalled because perps became a cultural default, not because they were structurally superior for all time horizons.  As those incentives compress, the demand for liquidation-free, cost-certain upside becomes obvious.  The remaining work is abstracting complexity without removing power - that’s the real unlock.

This is exactly right.  Perps are unmatched for short-term expression. But as time horizons extend, uncertainty compounds: funding, liquidation paths, and forced exits become the real risk — not being wrong on direction.  Options are the natural next frontier for crypto because they introduce certainty: fixed cost, defined downside, no liquidation. Yes, no liquidation. That’s how longer-term beliefs should be expressed.  The missing piece has never been demand — it’s accessibility. Options don’t need to replace perps. They need to exist alongside them, surfaced through interfaces that feel simple, intuitive, and familiar to retail.  Crypto is finally ready for liquidation-free convexity.
